positions.name: InstrumentalProbeVoice
positions.frame: how does a document perform its own instrumental self-awareness — naming itself as a vehicle for a governance assertion rather than presenting the assertion on its own terms?
positions.why: Both expressions share a single directional read: src-1 ratifies a governance rule (saving a memory enrolls its creator as reviewer) as a settled decision, and src-2 immediately subordinates the entire document to carrying that assertion. The register is uniformly technical and matter-of-fact; the conviction gradient (decision in src-1, claim in src-2) is held in tension — the document ratifies a rule and then frames itself as merely the instrument for that ratification. The relational and power dimensions reinforce this: both enact informational authority through a governance rule and its vehicle.
